t: Buy-Side vs. Sell-Side Equity Research: Detailed Guide
s: December 17, 2025 - In sell-side equity research, such as at large banks that produce equity research reports for clients, your job is to be a conduit by finding and passing along key information and connecting the right parties (e.g., management teams with investors). It’s a bonus if you can make solid stock recommendations, but it’s not strictly required to advance. By contrast, in buy-side equity research, your job is to make the right investment calls using the least amount of information/effort possible (decision paralysis and all that).
